_note: Gently Yonder's writers are pen names (disclosed on editors.html). Bios describe interests and how each writes; they never claim trips, credentials or checkable facts. beats = content_classes labels or slug patterns each one signs.

authors.name: Casey
authors.bio: Edits Gently Yonder and writes the hotel and booking guides. Likes a short walk from the station, a clear answer at the top of the page and a price that says what is included.

authors.name: Martin
authors.bio: Writes the guides you read before you leave home: insurance, money, packing and airports. Reads the policy wording so you can skip to the part that matters.

authors.name: Sophie
authors.bio: Covers the dates that fill hotels: carnivals, New Year's Eve, blossom and snow seasons. Starts every guide with when, where and how early to book.

authors.name: Mina
authors.bio: Writes the first-timer city guides and the food and café pages. Happiest working out which neighbourhood to wander and what to eat there.

authors.name: Elena
authors.bio: Plans the day-by-day itineraries and the when-to-go guides, with an eye for light, views and the hour when a place is quietest.

authors.name: Margaret
authors.bio: Writes the country profiles, culture and history pieces, and the tax explainers. Reads the sources twice and likes to say what was lost and what survives.
